scholarships.title: Ghana Scholarships Authority - Local Tertiary Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who have been admitted to, and registered at, a public university in Ghana for a STEM-related course or Law.
scholarships.coverage: Support towards studies at a Ghanaian public university. The amount is not stated in the 2026/2027 notice - confirm with the Authority.
scholarships.description: Apply online, sit an aptitude test during the application period, then attend a selection interview at a selected district assembly (MMDA). The 2026/2027 window ran from 10 April to 15 May 2026; the next window is expected around the same time of year.

scholarships.title: GETFund Local Scholarship (2026/2027)
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaians admitted to an accredited tertiary institution in Ghana (diploma, HND, bachelor's, master's or PhD). You need your admission letter and Ghana Card to apply.
scholarships.coverage: Tuition support for study in Ghana - confirm the exact terms on the official portal.
scholarships.description: Applications are made only on GETFund's scholarship portal. News reports give the 2026/2027 window as 5 October to 27 November 2026.

scholarships.title: MTN Bright Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian continuing students on a first degree, or on vocational and technical skills training, at a public tertiary institution in Ghana, with outstanding academic results, good conduct and no disciplinary action. Teachers furthering their education at public universities can also apply.
scholarships.coverage: Tuition, accommodation and essential learning resources. In 2026, 500 awards: 300 for STEM, vocational and technical students and 200 for teachers.
scholarships.description: Online application only, and free at every stage. The 2026 round opened on 22 April and closed on 31 May 2026.

scholarships.title: Ashesi University scholarships (including Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program)
scholarships.eligibility: Students admitted to Ashesi who apply for financial aid. Awards are based on demonstrated financial need and the strength of the admission application.
scholarships.coverage: From part of tuition up to the full cost of study, including housing, meals, learning materials and basic living expenses for some awards.
scholarships.description: Admission and scholarship decisions are made separately. Ashesi is one of the first nine universities in the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program.

scholarships.title: University of Ghana Students Financial Aid (UG Sponsorship and others)
scholarships.sponsor: University of Ghana Students Financial Aid Office
scholarships.eligibility: Bright but needy Ghanaian full-time, regular students of the University of Ghana.
scholarships.coverage: Full or partial scholarships, fee arrangements and work-study support.
scholarships.description: Calls are posted on the Financial Aid Office website. Applications for continuing students begin each November. The 2026/2027 UG Sponsorship call opened on 30 June 2026.

source.name: University of Ghana Students Financial Aid Office

scholarships.title: Presidential West African Scholarship Initiative (PWASI)
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of ECOWAS member states other than Ghana who meet the admission requirements of a participating public university in Ghana and show academic excellence and leadership potential. Candidates are nominated by their own country's nominating agency.
scholarships.coverage: Full-time, on-campus study at a public tertiary institution in Ghana: up to 4 years for undergraduate, 2 for master's and 4 for PhD.
scholarships.description: Priority fields include engineering, computing, health, agriculture, economics and business, governance and law, and environment. First apply for a programme at a participating Ghanaian public university, then submit documents on the GSA portal. Nominating agencies had to send endorsements by August 2026.

source.name: Ghana Scholarships Authority - PWASI 2026 call, 3 June 2026

scholarships.title: Joint Algeria/Ghana Government Scholarship
scholarships.sponsor: Governments of Algeria and Ghana (via Ghana Scholarships Authority)
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who completed SHS with current WASSCE results (2025 for the 2026/27 round), an aggregate of 13 or better, aged 23 or under, with a passport and birth record.
scholarships.coverage: Undergraduate study in science, technology, medicine, pharmacy, agriculture, architecture and related fields; two-year vocational and technical training; religious studies. Includes one year of French language training.
scholarships.description: Register on the GSA website under 'Algerian Government Scholarship', then submit the printed form with your WASSCE result slips and transcript. The 2026/27 deadline was 21 September 2026.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum (Government of Hungary)
scholarships.sponsor: Government of Hungary (Ghana nominations via Ghana Scholarships Authority)
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana. Undergraduate: recent WASSCE with an aggregate between 6 and 15, aged 23 or under. Master's/PhD: a relevant degree with Second Class Upper or better, two years' experience after graduating, national service completed, and aged 35 or under (master's) or 45 or under (PhD).
scholarships.coverage: Study in Hungary at undergraduate, master's or doctoral level in the programmes listed on the Stipendium Hungaricum site.
scholarships.description: Apply online at stipendiumhungaricum.hu and also send a written application to the Ghana Scholarships Authority. The 2026/27 round closed on 16 January 2026; the 2027/28 call had not been published when this was checked.

scholarships.title: Mauritius-Africa Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.sponsor: Government of Mauritius (via Ghana Scholarships Authority)
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who have applied to a public higher education institution in Mauritius. Undergraduate applicants must be at least 18 and under 26 on 1 January of the award year; MPhil/PhD applicants under 40.
scholarships.coverage: Full-time, on-campus diploma, degree, master's, MPhil or PhD study at a public institution in Mauritius. Financial components follow the scheme's terms.
scholarships.description: First apply for admission in Mauritius, then submit your offer or acknowledgement through the Ghana Scholarships Authority. The 2026/27 call was published on 12 February 2026.
scholarships.deadline: Announced yearly - check the official notice

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (master's and PhD)
scholarships.sponsor: Government of China (via Ghana Scholarships Authority)
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana. Master's: a first degree with Second Class Upper or better, aged 35 or under. PhD: Second Class Upper plus a relevant master's, aged 40 or under. Must be medically fit; women are encouraged to apply.
scholarships.coverage: Master's or doctoral study at a Chinese Government Scholarship university.
scholarships.description: Apply online through campuschina.org (Type A, agency number 2881), then send the hard copies to the Ghana Scholarships Authority. The 2026/27 round closed in December 2025.

scholarships.title: Learn Africa Programme for African Women (Spain)
scholarships.sponsor: Government of Spain / Mujeres por Africa (via Ghana Scholarships Authority)
scholarships.eligibility: Ghanaian women holding at least a university diploma or degree who meet the requirements of the chosen course.
scholarships.coverage: Postgraduate study at Spanish academic institutions - see the programme site for benefits.
scholarships.description: The 2026/27 window ran from 1 to 19 April 2026. Applications go through the programme's own website.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships (UK)
scholarships.sponsor: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (FCDO)
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens and permanent residents of eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries, including Ghana, Nigeria, Sierra Leone and The Gambia, who could not otherwise afford to study in the UK. You must also apply for admission to your UK courses.
scholarships.coverage: Full-time taught master's study at a UK university.
scholarships.description: Applications go through the CSC's own system (CSC Central), and the CSC does not charge to apply. The 2027/28 round closed at 16:00 BST on 20 October 2026.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarships (UK)
scholarships.sponsor: UK Government (Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries (Ghana has its own Chevening page) applying for a one-year master's at a UK university. Check the country page for current criteria.
scholarships.coverage: One-year master's study in the UK.
scholarships.description: Applications for 2027/28 opened in August 2026 and closed on 6 October 2026 (11:00 UTC). Shortlisting runs from February 2027, with interviews in March and April.

scholarships.title: DAAD Research Grants - Doctoral Programmes in Germany
scholarships.sponsor: DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service), funded by the German Federal Foreign Office
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates applying from eligible countries (the DAAD list includes Ghana, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, Liberia and The Gambia) who want to complete a doctorate in Germany. As a rule, your most recent degree should be no more than six years old at the deadline.
scholarships.coverage: A scholarship to complete a doctoral degree in Germany.
scholarships.description: Deadlines are updated each year in the second quarter and are usually in the same period as the year before. The portal opens only during the application period.
scholarships.deadline: Announced yearly - check the DAAD database

source.name: DAAD scholarship database - Doctoral Programmes in Germany

scholarships.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship - Undergraduate, Embassy Recommendation
scholarships.sponsor: Government of Japan (MEXT), through Japanese embassies
scholarships.eligibility: Recent secondary school graduates who meet the age and academic rules in the year's application guidelines and apply through the Japanese embassy in their own country.
scholarships.coverage: Undergraduate study at a Japanese university.
scholarships.description: Recruitment runs from April to May of the year before arrival, and embassies do the first screening between May and August. Do not send documents directly to MEXT. Ask the Embassy of Japan in your country for its dates.
scholarships.deadline: Announced yearly by the Japanese embassy (usually April-May)

source.name: Study in Japan (official) - MEXT undergraduate, embassy recommendation

scholarships.title: Turkiye Scholarships (Turkiye Burslari)
scholarships.eligibility: International students with strong academic results. The programme is competitive and merit-based.
scholarships.coverage: Financial support plus university placement in Turkiye - see the official site for the full package.
scholarships.description: Apply online, free of charge, through the official application system. Check the 'Application Calendar' on the site for the current round.
scholarships.deadline: Announced yearly - check the Application Calendar

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters scholarships (EU)
scholarships.eligibility: Students from any country with a bachelor's degree (or a recognised equivalent) who apply to an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's programme.
scholarships.coverage: Full scholarships for the best-ranked applicants, covering participation costs with a contribution to living costs.
scholarships.description: Apply directly to the programme running your chosen master's. Each programme sets its own deadline.

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.eligibility: Young Africans, especially from under-served backgrounds, who apply to one of the programme's partner universities. Admission to a partner does not guarantee a scholarship.
scholarships.coverage: Scholarship support through partner universities - each partner sets its own package.
scholarships.description: There is no central application: apply through a partner university (in Ghana, for example, Ashesi University). Each partner sets its own deadline. If a partner charges an application fee, it is refunded to candidates who are selected.

scholarships.title: African Leadership Academy - Diploma Programme (need-based aid)
scholarships.eligibility: Young Africans born on or after 1 September 2007 (for the 2027-2028 school year) applying to ALA's two-year pre-university diploma programme in South Africa.
scholarships.coverage: Need-based financial aid. ALA reports that most of its students receive financial help.
scholarships.description: Apply online. For the Class of 2027 the Early Decision deadline was 15 October 2026 and the Regular Decision deadline is 15 January 2027.
